source_notes: The x-series formulas are nominal precursor-ratio labels. Figure 6 EDX shows deviations and sulfur deficiency; do not call nominal formulas exact product stoichiometry.
Figure 4(a–f) panel order is x=.75,.45,.25,.10,.05,0; Figure 4(g) summarizes dimension and morphology transition only for x=.75 through .10. Figure 2 panel order is x=0,.05,.10,.25,.45,.75.
Figure 5(a) XRD shows all six variants, whereas Figure 5(b) Raman shows x=.10,.25,.45,.75 only; Figure 6 EDX covers only x=.10,.25,.45,.75.
The x=.05 TEM sample is a quaternary-aggregate/ZnS particle mixture, not one homogeneous 24.2 nm species. Scherrer D and TEM particle dimensions remain distinct.
Source Figure 3 includes a published Cu2SnS3 (x=1) comparison point. This is not a seventh synthesized recipe in the scoped article.
The paper's film deposition and PEC measurements are downstream from these colloidal nanocrystal preparations and do not create additional nanocrystal synthesis records.
evidence_conflicts: Table 1 labels x=0.45 and x=0.25 kesterite while text notes very weak approximately 27° wurtzite features; retain both statements.
x=0.05 is a mixture of quaternary aggregates and approximately 3 nm ZnS; its 24.2 nm Scherrer value must not label every TEM particle.
remaining_gaps: No paper-supplied individual metal-salt charge list; per-metal mmol are explicitly calculated from reported total and stoichiometric ratio.

No measured sample-specific atomic coordinate asset; reference kesterite unit cell unavailable in current local registry.
For x=0.45/0.25, TEM length/diameter are graphical but not numerically tabulated; no digitized values assigned.
Main-text electrode/PEC sample preparation is downstream and not represented as a second colloidal synthesis.
Exact analyzed EDX composition differs from the nominal x-series formula; Figure 6 reports sulfur deficiency and composition deviation, not an exact formula for every product.

items.title: Shared hot-injection procedure with six separate cation ratios
items.summary: The 1.6 mmol total metal salts, 20.0 mL flask oleylamine, 135 °C/120 min vacuum stage, Ar heating to 245 °C, S–oleylamine injection and 60 min growth are source-bound; individual metal charges are explicitly calculated from the nominal ratios.

items.title: Figure 4 TEM and Figure 5 XRD/Raman sample series
items.summary: Spherical x=.75 particles transition through rods/wires to small ZnS and a heterogeneous x=.05 mixture. Figure 4(g) summarizes x=.75–.10 dimensions, Figure 5(a) XRD covers six samples, and Figure 5(b) Raman only x=.10–.75.

items.summary: Source EDX reports deviations and sulfur deficiency for x=.10,.25,.45,.75; x=.05 and x=0 have no Figure 6 EDX point. Formula labels identify the nominal precursor series.
